samples.source:
Draw in the raging fires and envelop yourself in them. Remove all burns from enemies in a radius of 5 around you, and create a shield lasting %d turns with a power of %d, increased by 15%% for each burn removed.
		When the shield ends, it releases a burst of fire in a radius of %d around you, burning all enemies for 3 turns, doing damage equal to the initial power of the shield.
samples.target:
吸取燃烧中的烈焰，将自己包裹其中。
		除去半径 5 内的敌方生物身上的燃烧效果，同时制造一层持续 %d 轮的 %d 强度的护盾，每吸收一层燃烧效果护盾强度增加 15%%。
		当护盾效果结束时，将在半径 %d 范围内释放一次火焰爆炸，灼烧周围生物 3 回合，造成等于护盾初始值的伤害。

samples.source:
The power of the Fearscape infuses your weapon: Your melee attacks will deal %0.2f fire damage, spread over 3 turns.
		Additionally, every time you attack, there is a %d%% chance of releasing a burst of powerful fire that will deal %0.2f fire damage to all enemies in radius %d over %d turns.
		If this talent is not on cooldown, the burst of fire will instead be radius %d, and stun all targets in addition to burning them.
		For the purposes of applying the stun, you have %d bonus spellpower.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
samples.target:
恶魔空间的力量注入你的武器：你的近战攻击在 3 回合内造成 %0.2f 点火焰伤害。
	另外，每次攻击时有 %d%% 几率造成 %0.2f 火焰燃烧伤害， %d 码内的所有敌人都会受到此伤害，燃烧持续 %d 回合。
	若该技能冷却完毕，则火焰爆发将聚集在 %d 码范围内，并产生火焰震慑效果。
	进行震慑判定时，额外增加 %d 点法术强度。
	伤害受法术强度加成。

samples.source: The target is surrounded by a magical shield, absorbing %d/%d damage before it crumbles and dealing %d damage in a radius of %d when it does.
samples.target: 目标被一层魔法护盾包围，吸收 %d/%d 伤害，护盾结束时（无论吸收耗尽还是自然到期），引燃持续 3 回合、每回合造成 %d 伤害且范围为半径 %d 的灼烧。

samples.source:
Conjures up a bolt of fire, setting the target ablaze and doing %0.2f fire damage over 3 turns.
		At level 5, it will create a beam of flames.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
samples.target:
制造一个火球，使目标进入灼烧状态并在 3 回合内造成 %0.2f 火焰伤害。
		在等级 5 时，火焰会有穿透效果。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

facts: Default duration is 3 and initial percentage is 50.
init_dam is dam * perc / 100; the remainder is assigned to EFF_BURNING with power = remaining dam / dur.
on_merge preserves remaining-plus-new damage before recomputing power.
on_timeout projects eff.power as fire damage.
The shield deactivation projects FIREBURN with dur=3 and dam=spellCrit(eff.power).
English says the shield-end burst burns enemies for 3 turns and does damage equal to the shield's initial power.
The melee proc passes its displayed dam to FIREBURN; the burst passes displayed dam with an explicit duration.
